title: POLITICS: Pretraining with Same-story Article Comparison for Ideology Prediction and Stance Detection
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings related to religion or the 'Atheism' stance detection target. The results for the SemEval dataset are aggregated across all targets (Atheism, Climate Change, Feminist, Hillary Clinton, Abortion, and Donald Trump), so no specific conclusions about the model's performance on religious topics can be drawn.
